plan.notes: Source: official University of Wyoming College of Engineering & Physical Sciences 2025-2026 Computer Science advising sheet (8-semester grid), https://www.uwyo.edu/ceps/_files/academics/advising/docs/2025-cosc.pdf . Document year: 2025-2026 Catalog Year. Transcription method: PDF text extracted and transcribed term-by-term from the sheet's freshman->senior Fall/Spring grids; no semester placement was invented. This is the ADVISING SHEET, not the catalog; requirement details (elective rules, approved course lists) come from the sheet's footnotes. Credential: UW's true program name is 'Computer Science, B.S.' (Bachelor of Science in Computer Science), Department of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science; sheet's computer-organization course is listed as EE 2150 (transcribed as shown). Minimum grades on the sheet (no per-course grade field in schema): all COSC, MATH and STAT courses require C or better; other courses D or better; no S/U grading for degree requirements. MATH 2200 placement: C in MATH 1405 or MATH 1450 (course codes in external_prereqs) OR Math Placement Exam level 5 OR Math ACT 27 OR Math SAT 640 (placement/assessment details here per schema rule). MATH 2250 alternate prereq MATH 2350 is a course not in this plan (external_prereqs). COSC 3050 requires junior standing and COSC major (not a course code). USP Communications II requires C in COM1 and COM3 requires C in COM2 (modeled via the USP-C1/USP-C2 placeholder slots). Courses with requirement options (Systems, Theory, O/S, Programming Language) are offered in alternating Fall/Spring semesters per the sheet; see advisor. Sheet program rules: minimum 120 total credits, 42 upper-division credits, 30 math/science credits; COSC electives at/above 3000 level (max 3 cr COSC 3970); math/science electives from the department list with advisor approval. Catalog (acalogcatalog.uwyo.edu, 'Computer Science, B.S.') used ONLY to confirm the true degree name and full titles of the option courses in choice notes; semester placement and course list come from the advising sheet.
